$comment: Promotion checks run against the deployed semantic model over XMLA. Source SQL runs against the environment's database (SQL_DATABASE: newmont_test for Dev/QA, newmont_prod for Prod); {schema} is replaced with SQL_SCHEMA (gold). Each 'sql' check compares the DAX result to the source; 'expected' compares to a literal; 'expectError' asserts the query is blocked (OLS).

dataValidation.name: No orphan facts (every fact row has a site)

security.name: RLS: 'North America' sees exactly one region
RLS: 'North America' gold ounces match source for that region
security.sql: SELECT SUM(f.GoldOunces) FROM [{schema}].[FactProduction] f JOIN [{schema}].[DimSite] s ON s.SiteKey = f.SiteKey WHERE s.Region = 'North America'

security.name: OLS: 'Restricted Cost' can still query gold ounces
